Sample hash-bucket from Karnataka SIR 2026 ASD (uncollectable elector) deletion index. Row schema: [sha256_suffix_of_EPIC, AC_no, part_no, serial, reason_code, old_part, old_serial, name_Kannada, relative_name_Kannada] — names plaintext; reason codes e.g. SHIFTED/DEAD/DUPLICATE. Source: ECI's per-part ASD PDFs reformatted by the project.
Coverage manifest for the Karnataka ASD index (not tabular): 10,766,778 deletion rows, 224/224 ACs, 100% of 60,305 parts, 0 unreadable. Per-AC row counts and coverage figures.

Sample hash-bucket from Karnataka SIR 2026 discrepancy/no-mapping notices index (parsed from CEO's 34 Google Drive district folders). Row schema: [sha256_suffix_of_EPIC, AC_no, part_no, serial, notice_reason, age, gender, name_Latin, drive_file_id] — names plaintext. Project reports 4,340,895 notices total (99.06% of CEO count).

Sample hash-bucket from companion Karnataka ASDDO deletion dashboard. Row schema (from docs/app.js decodeRecord): [suffix, name_English, relative_name_English, relation_idx, age, serial, reason_idx, ac_idx, file_idx, dup] — names plaintext; reason_idx maps to absent/shifted/death/duplicate/others. Cross-verified: hash suffix '0039ca48' matches the same voter in the gouthamganeshm ASD bucket, name in Kannada there, English here.

Aggregate stats for the companion Karnataka ASDDO dataset (not tabular): 10,846,382 total ASDDO records (absent 15.4L, shifted 65.6L, death 16.4L, duplicate 7.0L, others 4.0L), district/age-band breakdowns.
